decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also utilizing cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Omen of the Sea to maintain card advantage. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Thundertrap Trainer to close out the game. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value and flexibility in the strategy. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory in the long game.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with instant and sorcery spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield multiple times in a single turn. It utilizes a combination of cheap spells, card draw, and burn spells to efficiently control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes some extra turns effects and disruptive spells to further disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast and aggressive playstyle.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by using cards like Thoughtseize, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Fatal Push to control the board and hand. The deck also includes various ways to generate card advantage and manipulate the opponent's draws with cards like Omen of the Sea and Grim Bauble. The deck aims to grind out the opponent with incremental advantages while controlling the game tempo. Yorion, Sky Nomad acts as a powerful companion that can provide additional value by blinking key permanents for additional value.

This deck focuses on utilizing the interactions between Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck includes cards like Fear of Missing Out and Bitter Triumph to support the combo strategy, while also including cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push for disruption and removal. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure victory against opponents in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to outmaneuver and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining removal spells, hand disruption, and card draw, the deck aims to establish board control and limit the opponent's options. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion provides additional value and flexibility, allowing for more opportunities to stabilize and grind out a win. With a mix of powerful individual cards and synergistic interactions, the Dimir Control archetype aims to maintain dominance over the battlefield and emerge victorious in 1 vs 1 Pioneer matches.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of burn spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and maintain a steady stream of threats throughout the game. The creatures are efficient and can provide additional value or disruption, while the burn spells can help finish off the opponent or remove blockers. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for both early aggression and late-game power.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures and generating value through triggers and abilities such as Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven. By constantly sacrificing and recurring creatures, players can chip away at their opponent's life total while also disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute adds extra flexibility and interaction. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats and removal spells, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and resource advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse while using disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes versatile removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy, leading to a fast and aggressive playstyle.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, card advantage engines, and disruptive creatures to dominate the opponent's resources and win the game through attrition. The deck includes strong control pieces like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with card draw engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Omen of the Sea. It also utilizes powerful finishers like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its dual-color requirements and maximize its efficiency.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to constantly tutor for powerful creatures, providing a strong control element by being able to adapt to various situations. The deck includes a variety of creatures with different abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also incorporating Leyline Binding for additional control. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck, allowing for consistency in casting spells and activating abilities. Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by flickering permanents for extra advantage.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively and quickly, using cards like Arclight Phoenix and Picklock Prankster to put pressure on the opponent. It also includes lots of card draw and cheap removal spells to maintain control of the board and keep the pressure on. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient spells, using the synergy between cards like Artist's Talent and Sleight of Hand to maximize value and keep the deck running smoothly.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing powerful creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to quickly put pressure on the opponent. Cards like Infuriate and Reckless Rage allow for quick bursts of damage, while cards like Fatal Push provide removal options. The deck also includes direct damage spells like Monstrous Rage and Heartfire Hero to finish off opponents or clear the way for attacks. The mana base is built around Blackcleave Cliffs and Blood Crypt, ensuring a consistent flow of resources for the aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain a strong defensive strategy while disrupting your opponent's game plan through card advantage and removal spells. With a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking effects, while cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hopeless Nightmare provide additional disruption and card advantage. The deck also includes win conditions like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games.

This control deck focuses on utilizing creatures with the Overlord mechanic to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to establish a formidable board presence while also using cards like Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse to remove threats from the opponent's side of the field. Zur, Eternal Schemer serves as a powerful commander that can search for key cards to further control the game. The mana base is also built to support the deck's strategy with a mix of lands that provide different colors of mana to cast spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and mana acceleration to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures, while also disrupting their game plan with cards that slow down their spells. By curving out with efficient creatures like Llanowar Elves and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain tempo throughout the game. Collected Company allows for additional creature deployment at instant speed, providing flexibility and surprise factor. The deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive strategy while also incorporating utility lands for additional benefits.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hand disruption and removal spells while maintaining card advantage with Narset and Yorion. The deck aims to control the game with a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw until it can establish a powerful board presence with creatures like Kaito and Sheoldred. The deck also utilizes powerful lands such as Shipwreck Marsh and Fetid Pools to fix mana and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck is designed to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a long game.
